jobs.occupation: wissenschaftliche\*r Mitarbeiter\*in (Post-Doc) (w/m/d) (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description: Die Universität Paderborn ist eine leistungsstarke und international orientierte Campus-Universität. In interdisziplinären Teams gestalten wir zukunftsweisende Forschung, innovative Lehre sowie den aktiven Wissenstransfer in die Gesellschaft. Als wichtige Forschungs- und Kooperationspartnerin prägt die Universität auch regionale Entwicklungsstrategien. Unseren Beschäftigten in Forschung, Lehre, Technik und Verwaltung bieten wir ein lebendiges, familienfreundliches und chancengerechtes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und vielfältigen Möglichkeiten. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft!In der Fakultät für Naturwissenschaften – Department Chemie – ist im Rahmen des interdisziplinären Forschungsvorhabens ML4Fouling zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Stelle alswissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in (Post-Doc) (w/m/d) (Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L)im Umfang von 100 % der regelmäßigen Arbeitszeit zu besetzen. Es handelt sich um eine Qualifizierungsstelle im Sinne des Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetzes (WissZeitVG), die zur Förderung der folgenden wiss. Qualifizierung besetzt wird: Projektakquise und -management im Bereich der Naturwissenschaften. Die Stelle ist befristet, abhängig von der bisher erreichten Qualifizierung, jedoch für die Dauer von i. d. R. 2 Jahren zu besetzen, da dieser Zeitraum zur Förderung des Qualifizierungsziels als angemessen angesehen wird.Aufgabenbereich:• Durchführung experimenteller (u. a. elektrochemischer, spektroskopischer, mikroskopischer) Analysen zur Detektion initialerAblagerungsprozesse an umströmten Oberflächen• Analyse des Einflusses von Materialeigenschaften, Fluidzusammensetzung und Strömungsbedingungen auf makromolekulareAblagerungsprozesse• Atomistische Simulation (sowohl DFT- als auch Kraftfeld-basiert) von Adsorptions- und Desorptionsprozessen an Fest-Flüssig-Grenzflächen• Entwicklung und Validierung von Machine-Learning-Modellen zur Vorhersage der Belagsbildung in technischen und medizintechnischenSystemen• Präsentation der wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnisse in nationalen und internationalen Konferenzen• Publikation der wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnisse in internationalen Fachzeitschriften• Lehrverpflichtung im Umfang von i. d. R. 4 SWS, primär in deutschsprachigen VeranstaltungenEinstellungsvoraussetzungen:• Abgeschlossene Promotion in Chemie, Physik, Materialwissenschaft oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich• Nachgewiesene Kenntnisse im Bereich Elektrochemie, Grenzflächenchemie und/oder -analytik sowie atomistischen Simulationen• Kenntnisse im Bereich maschinelles Lernen und/oder in der Arbeit mit datengetriebenen Methoden sowie der Erzeugung entsprechenderTrainingsdaten sind wünschenswert• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und SchriftWir bieten Ihnen:• Ein interdisziplinäres Forschungsumfeld an der Schnittstelle von Technischer Chemie, Theoretischer Chemie und Machine-Learning• Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem universitätsintern ausgezeichneten Forschungsprojekt• Zugang zu den Hochleistungsrechnern des Paderborn Center for Parallel Computing (PC2)• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung sowie die individuelle Möglichkeit zur mobilen Arbeit• Vielzahl von Gesundheits-, Beratungs- und Präventionsangeboten• Attraktive Nebenleistungen wie Kinderbetreuungsmöglichkeiten und Sportangebote• Möglichkeit zur internen und externen Fort- und Weiterbildung• Zusätzliche Leistungen nach dem Tarifvertrag der Länder (TV-L) wie Jahressonderzahlung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen sowie dieZusatzversorgung der VBLBewerbungen von Frauen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht und werden gem. Landesgleichstellungsgesetz NRW (LGG) bei gleicher Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung bevorzugt berücksichtigt, sofern nicht in der Person eines Mitbewerbers liegende Gründe überwiegen. Teilzeitbeschäftigung ist grundsätzlich möglich. Ebenso ist die Bewerbung geeigneter Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter im Sinne des Sozialgesetzbuches Neuntes Buch (SGB IX) erwünscht.Bewerbungen mit den üblichen Unterlagen werden unter Angabe der Kennziffer 7460 bis zum 4. Dezember 2026 erbeten an vanessa.nesslinger@unipaderborn.de.Informationen zur Verarbeitung Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten finden Sie unter:www.uni-paderborn.de/zv/personaldatenschutz.Prof. Dr. Martin BrehmFakultät für NaturwissenschaftenUniversität PaderbornWarburger Str. 10033098 PaderbornPaderborn University is a high-performance and internationally oriented university. Within interdisciplinary teams, we undertake forward-looking research, design innovative teaching concepts and actively transfer knowledge into society. As an important research and cooperation partner, the university also shapes regional development strategies. We offer our employees in research, teaching, technology and administration a lively, family-friendly and equal opportunity environment, a lean management structure and diverse opportunities. Join us to invent the future!As part of the interdisciplinary research project ML4Fouling, at the Faculty of Science – Department of Chemistry –, the following position is to be filled as soon as possiblePostdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d)(Salary level according to 13 TV-L)with 100% of the regular working hours. This is a qualification position within the meaning of the German Act on Fixed-Term Research Employment Contracts for Academic Staff (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz “WissZeitVG”), which serves to promote the following academic qualification: project acquisition and management in natural sciences. The position is initially limited for a period of two years.Duties and responsibilities:• Conducting experimental (including electrochemical, spectroscopic, and microscopic) analyses to detect initial adsorption processes on surfaces exposed to fluid flow• Analyzing the influence of material properties, fluid composition, and flow conditions on macromolecular deposition processes• Atomistic simulation (both DFT- and force-field-based) of adsorption and desorption processes at solid-liquid interfaces• Developing and validating predictive machine learning (ML) models for deposition processes in technical and biomedical systems• Presenting scientific findings at national and international conferences• Publishing scientific findings in international peer-reviewed journals• Teaching duties usually amounting to 4 teaching hours (SWS) per week, primarily in German-language coursesRecruitment requirements:• Completed PhD in chemistry, physics, materials science, or a related field in the natural sciences• Proven knowledge in the fields of electrochemistry, interface chemistry and/or interface analysis, as well as atomistic simulations• Knowledge in the field of machine learning and/or in working with data-driven methods, as well as the generation of corresponding training data, is desirable• Excellent written and spoken English skillsWe offer:• An interdisciplinary research environment bridging technical chemistry, theoretical chemistry, and machine learning• The opportunity to be part of a research project recognized with a university award• Access to the high-performance computing facilities of the Paderborn Center for Parallel Computing (PC2)• Flexible working hours and the individual option of mobile working• Wide range of health, counseling and prevention services• Attractive fringe benefits such as childcare facilities and sports activities• Opportunities for internal and external training and development• Additional benefits in accordance with the collective agreement of the federal states (TV-L), such as annual bonuses and capital-forming benefits as well as the VBL supplementary pension schemeApplications from women are particularly welcome and, in case of equal qualifications and experiences, will receive preferential treatment according to state law (LGG), unless there are preponderant reasons to give preference to another applicant. Part-time employment is generally possible. Applications from disabled people with appropriate suitability are explicitly welcome. This also applies to people with equal opportunities in accordance with the German social law SGB IX.Please send your application documents (preferably in a single pdf file) using the Ref. No. 7460 until December, 4th 2026 to vanessa.nesslinger@uni-paderborn.de.

jobs.description: With about 15,000 students, more than 300 professorships and around 160 degree programs, the RPTU University Kaiserslautern-Landau is the technical university of the state of Rhineland-Palatinate. As a place of top international research, it offers excellent working conditions and career opportunities. The position is assigned to the team of Prof. Dr. Michaela Maier. We are looking for a person with a clear scientific qualification goal.We offer integration into a dynamic, highly motivated working group, which provides both opportunities for collaboration and exchange as well as the freedom to develop your own ideas.Your area of responsibility:- The position’s main teaching focus is in environmental communication.- Teaching duties are based on the statutory provisions of the HLehrVO.Your requirements profile:- an excellent Bachelor's AND Master's degree in Communication Science- Interest in environmental communication is mandatory; interest in computational social sciences and journalism research is highly welcome.- Very good German, English and methodological skills are required; applicants should be able to teach in both German and English.- You enjoy working independently and have good organizational and communication skills.Weitere Informationen finden Sie auf unserer Homepage:https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/79896a746ef2fe490c2b36b38e6bd6781cea859f0 (https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/79896a746ef2fe490c2b36b38e6bd6781cea859f0)

jobs.occupation: Expert SAP S/4HANA Cloud Environment Engineer (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4HANA Cloud Environment Engineer (f/m/d) to join our Business Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche)  division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – As a part of the Product & Technology team, you will deploy and configure SAP BTP services. You will cooperate with business analysts, developers, and deployment teams to prevent and resolve technical issues, ensuring integration and optimization across platforms.Automation - You support the automation tools from SAP BTP (e.g. Build Process Automation) and drive continuous improvement with additional suitable tools. You implement security measures, ensure compliance, and engage stakeholders with clear, focused communication.Solutions – You define guidelines, standards, and manage infrastructure to deliver and maintain SAP S/4HANA-based processes and solutions, ensuring end-to-end integration and optimization within the cloud environment.Innovations – You assess emerging cloud technologies, evaluate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and SAP BTP innovations, and drive continuous improvement by leveraging tools for automation and efficiency.Your profile- You have completed your studies in computer science, economics, or a comparable field.- You bring several years of experience in SAP BTP management and SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud integrations.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms, especially SAP Business Technology Platform- You have extensive experience in configuring and optimizing SAP BTP to SAP S/4HANA integrations.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – We encourage you to choose your working hours and your working place the way that suits you and your lifestyle. We do not have core working hours and we also offer you the possibility of home office or temporary work from abroad. Always in accordance with operational requirements and labor law regulations. Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.occupation: Senior Expert Corporate M&A EMEA (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Senior Expert Corporate M&A EMEA (f/m/d) to join our Internal Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche) division starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You will support strategy and acquisition / carve-out projects for PwC across EMEA. In doing so, you will identify growth opportunities, conduct market and sector analyses, and contribute to market sizing, competitive benchmarking, portfolio reviews, and commercial due diligences. Advisory - You will support senior team members in translating complex data into strategic recommendations that help shape PwC’s market position, profitability, and return on investment. You will also build your internal and external network across PwC, its advisors, and other professional services firms.  Transformation - You will contribute to deal pipelines and value creation plans in integration and carve-out projects, supporting a smooth transition from strategy to execution. This includes close collaboration with business units, internal functions such as Finance, and internal and external advisors across the deal lifecycle.Your profile- You have completed or are about to complete your studies in Business Administration, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering or Natural Sciences with a business-related focus.- You have gained more than three years of professional experience in Strategy Consulting, Private Equity, Corporate Development or In-house M&A and have worked across different stages of the deal lifecycle.- Experience in portfolio reviews, market assessments, commercial due diligence, transformation initiatives and value creation projects enables you to develop robust analyses and support strategic decision-making in a dynamic environment.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written. The team language is English.- You enjoy working in diverse international teams, navigate complex stakeholder environments with confidence and bring the flexibility to travel occasionally across the EMEA region when projects require it.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and  divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website. At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society.  In our Business Services we cover internal topics such as HR, Marketing, Finance, Middle Office, IT or our internal legal advice. Drive the development of PwC Germany in our various teams and use your expertise to strengthen our position as a potential employer. We offer you an exciting working environment where you can contribute your ideas and skills. ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.
